     3	/-!
     4	# Question and answer transport for the directly indexed low-degree game
     5	
     6	This module reads mature low individual degree questions as canonical direct
     7	questions and rebases direct answers to the mature line parametrization.
     8	
     9	Points and lines are decoded with the coordinate order reversed
    10	(`directPointEquiv`), so that the suffix-zero direction restriction of the
    11	mature diagonal test becomes the prefix-zero restriction of the direct game.
    12	A mature diagonal line reveals no coordinate index, whereas a direct diagonal
    13	question carries one.  The transported question uses the *leading index* of
    14	the decoded direction, the least coordinate at which the direction is
    15	nonzero.  Under the direct sampler, this is the index attached to the sampled
    16	direction exactly when the direction is nonzero at the sampled index
    17	(`directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection`), an event of conditional
    18	probability `1 - 1/q`; on the mature side, the leading index of a decoded
    19	`j`-restricted direction is `Fin.rev j` exactly when its pivot coordinate is
    20	nonzero (`directDiagonalIndexOf_extendRestrictedDirection`).  Diagonal answers
    21	on zero-direction lines are read as the constant polynomial carrying their
    22	value at the base point, following `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`.
    23	
    24	## References
    25	
    26	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:230-272`
    27	- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65`
    28	- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:120-121`
    29	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    30	-/
    31	
    32	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    33	
    34	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    35	
    36	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    37	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	/-! ## Canonical line rebasing for the mature LDT interface -/
    42	
    43	/-- A chosen affine parameter expressing a point relative to its canonical
    44	line representative. -/
    45	noncomputable def directLineRepParameter
    46	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) : K :=
    47	  Classical.choose (mem_linePoints_lineRepMap v u)
    48	
    49	/-- The chosen canonical rebase parameter reconstructs the original point. -/
    50	theorem directLineRepParameter_spec
    51	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) :
    52	    u = lineRepMap v u + directLineRepParameter v u • v :=
    53	  Classical.choose_spec (mem_linePoints_lineRepMap v u)
    54	
    55	/-- Canonical line representatives are unchanged by translation along their
    56	direction. -/
    57	theorem lineRepMap_add_smul
    58	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    59	    (v u : Fin m → K) (t : K) :
    60	    lineRepMap v (u + t • v) = lineRepMap v u := by
    61	  let W : Submodule K (Fin m → K) := Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K))
    62	  have hv : v ∈ W := Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton v)
    63	  have hzero : lineRepMap v v = 0 := by
    64	    simp [lineRepMap, canonicalProjOfKernel, W, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    65	      Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_right
    66	        (isCompl_registerSubmodule_canonicalComplement W).symm hv]
    67	  simp [map_add, map_smul, hzero]
    68	
    69	/-- For a nonzero direction, the canonical rebase parameter is unique. -/
    70	theorem directLineRepParameter_eq_of_nonzero
    71	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    72	    {v u : Fin m → K} (hv : v ≠ 0) {t : K}
    73	    (ht : u = lineRepMap v u + t • v) :
    74	    directLineRepParameter v u = t := by
    75	  have hfun : directLineRepParameter v u • v = t • v := by
    76	    apply add_left_cancel (a := lineRepMap v u)
    77	    exact (directLineRepParameter_spec v u).symm.trans ht
    78	  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 := by
    79	    by_contra h
    80	    apply hv
    81	    funext i
    82	    simpa using not_exists.mp h i
    83	  have hcoord := congrFun hfun i
    84	  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hcoord
    85	  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hi hcoord
    86	
    87	/-- Translating a point on a nonzero line adds the translation to its
    88	canonical rebase parameter. -/
    89	theorem directLineRepParameter_add_smul
    90	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    91	    {v u : Fin m → K} (hv : v ≠ 0) (t : K) :
    92	    directLineRepParameter v (u + t • v) =
    93	      directLineRepParameter v u + t := by
    94	  apply directLineRepParameter_eq_of_nonzero hv
    95	  rw [lineRepMap_add_smul]
    96	  calc
    97	    u + t • v =
    98	        (lineRepMap v u + directLineRepParameter v u • v) + t • v := by
    99	      rw [← directLineRepParameter_spec v u]
   100	    _ = lineRepMap v u + (directLineRepParameter v u + t) • v := by
   101	      module
   102	
   103	/-! ## The leading index of a direction -/
   104	
   105	/-- The coordinates at which a direct direction vector is nonzero. -/
   106	def directionSupport (D : DirectLdParams) (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   107	    Finset (Fin D.m) :=
   108	  open Classical in
   109	  Finset.univ.filter fun j => v j ≠ 0
   110	
   111	theorem mem_directionSupport (D : DirectLdParams)
   112	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (j : Fin D.m) :
   113	    j ∈ directionSupport D v ↔ v j ≠ 0 := by
   114	  simp [directionSupport]
   115	
   116	/-- The leading index of a direction: the least coordinate at which it is
   117	nonzero, or the last coordinate for the zero direction.  Every coordinate
   118	before the leading index vanishes, so a direction is the prefix projection of
   119	itself at its leading index, and the pair (leading index, direction) is a
   120	canonical direct diagonal sample.  It is the direct index of the sample
   121	whenever the sampled direction is nonzero at the sampled index. -/
   122	noncomputable def directDiagonalIndexOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   123	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.m :=
   124	  open Classical in
   125	  if h : (directionSupport D v).Nonempty then (directionSupport D v).min' h
   126	  else Fin.rev D.firstIndex
   127	
   128	/-- Coordinates before the leading index vanish. -/
   129	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_prefix_zero (D : DirectLdParams)
   130	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   131	    ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < (directDiagonalIndexOf D v).val → v j = 0 := by
   132	  classical
   133	  intro j hj
   134	  by_contra hne
   135	  have hmem : j ∈ directionSupport D v := (mem_directionSupport D v j).mpr hne
   136	  have hnonempty : (directionSupport D v).Nonempty := ⟨j, hmem⟩
   137	  have hle : directDiagonalIndexOf D v ≤ j := by
   138	    unfold directDiagonalIndexOf
   139	    rw [dif_pos hnonempty]
   140	    exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hmem
   141	  exact absurd (Fin.lt_def.mpr hj) (not_lt.mpr hle)
   142	
   143	/-- A direction vanishing before `i` and nonzero at `i` has leading index
   144	`i`. -/
   145	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_eq (D : DirectLdParams)
   146	    {v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D} {i : Fin D.m}
   147	    (hzero : ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < i.val → v j = 0) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
   148	    directDiagonalIndexOf D v = i := by
   149	  classical
   150	  have hmem : i ∈ directionSupport D v := (mem_directionSupport D v i).mpr hi
   151	  have hnonempty : (directionSupport D v).Nonempty := ⟨i, hmem⟩
   152	  unfold directDiagonalIndexOf
   153	  rw [dif_pos hnonempty]
   154	  apply le_antisymm
   155	  · exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hmem
   156	  · apply Finset.le_min'
   157	    intro j hj
   158	    by_contra hlt
   159	    exact (mem_directionSupport D v j).mp hj
   160	      (hzero j (Fin.lt_def.mp (not_le.mp hlt)))
   161	
   162	/-- The leading index of a prefix-projected direction is the projection index
   163	whenever the direction is nonzero there.  This is the generic direct
   164	diagonal sample: the sampled index is recovered from the projected direction
   165	alone. -/
   166	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection (D : DirectLdParams)
   167	    (i : Fin D.m) (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
   168	    directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v) = i := by
   169	  apply directDiagonalIndexOf_eq
   170	  · intro j hj
   171	    simp [directPrefixProjection, hj]
   172	  · simpa [directPrefixProjection] using hi
   173	
   174	/-- Prefix projection at the leading index is the identity. -/
   175	theorem directPrefixProjection_directDiagonalIndexOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   176	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   177	    directPrefixProjection (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v = v := by
   178	  funext j
   179	  unfold directPrefixProjection
   180	  split_ifs with hj
   181	  · exact (directDiagonalIndexOf_prefix_zero D v j hj).symm
   182	  · rfl
   183	
   184	/-! ## Decoding mature points and lines -/
   185	
   186	/-- Decode a mature LDT point into the fixed direct scalar field, reversing
   187	the coordinate order. -/
   188	abbrev ldtPointToDirect (D : DirectLdParams) :
   189	    Point D.toLDTParameters → Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
   190	  (directPointEquiv D).symm
   191	
   192	/-- The direct canonical axis question represented by a mature axis line.
   193	The mature coordinate index is reversed together with the point
   194	coordinates. -/
   195	noncomputable def directAxisQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   196	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   197	  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
   198	  let i : Fin D.m := Fin.rev line.direction
   199	  let v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D := coordinateDirection i
   200	  (.aline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, i, 0⟩)

201	
   202	/-- The direct canonical diagonal question represented by a mature diagonal
   203	line.  The decoded direction is kept and the direct index is its leading
   204	index, so the question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample
   205	formed by the decoded base, the leading index, and the decoded direction
   206	(`directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap`). -/
   207	noncomputable def directDiagonalQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   208	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   209	  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
   210	  let v := ldtPointToDirect D line.direction
   211	  (.dline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, directDiagonalIndexOf D v, v⟩)
   212	
   213	/-- The direct point question represented by a mature LDT point. -/
   214	noncomputable def directPointQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   215	    (u : Point D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   216	  directLdPointQuestionOf D (ldtPointToDirect D u)
   217	
   218	/-- Every transported diagonal question is the canonical direct question of
   219	the direct sample carrying the leading index, hence lies in the support of
   220	the direct diagonal sampler. -/
   221	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap (D : DirectLdParams)
   222	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   223	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D line =
   224	      (.dline, directLdMap D .dline
   225	        ⟨ldtPointToDirect D line.base,
   226	          directDiagonalIndexOf D (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction),
   227	          ldtPointToDirect D line.direction⟩) := by
   228	  unfold directDiagonalQuestionOf directLdMap
   229	  simp only [directPrefixProjection_directDiagonalIndexOf]
   230	
   231	/-- The mature diagonal line represented by a direct sample: the encoded
   232	point and the encoded direction. -/
   233	def matureDiagonalLineOf (D : DirectLdParams) (sample : DirectLdSpace D) :
   234	    DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters :=
   235	  { base := directPointEquiv D sample.point
   236	    direction := directPointEquiv D sample.direction }
   237	
   238	/-- Round trip on generic direct samples: when the sampled direction is
   239	nonzero at the sampled index, the mature line of the canonical direct
   240	diagonal question transports back to that question, index included. -/
   241	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_matureDiagonalLineOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   242	    (sample : DirectLdSpace D)
   243	    (hgeneric : sample.direction sample.index ≠ 0) :
   244	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D
   245	        (matureDiagonalLineOf D (directLdMap D .dline sample)) =
   246	      (.dline, directLdMap D .dline sample) := by
   247	  cases sample with
   248	  | mk point index direction =>
   249	      unfold directDiagonalQuestionOf matureDiagonalLineOf directLdMap
   250	      simp only [ldtPointToDirect, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, lineRepMap_apply_self,
   251	        directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection D index direction hgeneric]
   252	
   253	/-- A mature `j`-restricted diagonal direction decodes to a direct direction
   254	vanishing before index `Fin.rev j`: the suffix restriction of the mature
   255	test is the prefix restriction of the direct game. -/
   256	theorem ldtPointToDirect_extendRestrictedDirection_prefix_zero
   257	    (D : DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
   258	    (free : Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   259	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   260	    ∀ c : Fin D.m, c.val < (Fin.rev j).val →
   261	      ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j free) c = 0 := by
   262	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   263	  intro c hc
   264	  have hj := j.isLt
   265	  have hgt : ¬ (Fin.rev c).val ≤ j.val := by
   266	    rw [Fin.val_rev] at hc ⊢
   267	    omega
   268	  simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply,
   269	    extendRestrictedDirection, dif_neg hgt]
   270	  exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply 0
   271	
   272	/-- The leading index of a decoded `j`-restricted direction is `Fin.rev j`
   273	exactly on the generic event that its pivot coordinate `j` is nonzero. -/
   274	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_extendRestrictedDirection
   275	    (D : DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
   276	    (free : Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   277	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   278	    free ⟨j.val, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩ ≠ zeroCoord →
   279	      directDiagonalIndexOf D
   280	          (ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j free)) =
   281	        Fin.rev j := by
   282	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   283	  intro hpivot
   284	  apply directDiagonalIndexOf_eq
   285	  · exact ldtPointToDirect_extendRestrictedDirection_prefix_zero D j free
   286	  · simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply, Fin.rev_rev,
   287	      extendRestrictedDirection, dif_pos (le_refl j.val)]
   288	    intro h
   289	    apply hpivot
   290	    have hcoded := congrArg (directScalarEquiv D) h
   291	    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hcoded
   292	    exact hcoded
   293	
   294	/-! ## Rebasing lines -/
   295	
   296	/-- Decoding an axis-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar along
   297	the reversed direct coordinate direction. -/
   298	theorem ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   299	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   300	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   301	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   302	    ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
   303	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   304	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t •
   305	          coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction) := by
   306	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   307	  funext i
   308	  simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply,
   309	    AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt, AxisParallelLine.pointAt, Pi.add_apply,
   310	    Pi.smul_apply]
   311	  by_cases hi : i = Fin.rev line.direction
   312	  · subst hi
   313	    simp only [coordinateDirection, Fin.rev_rev, if_pos, smul_eq_mul]
   314	    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, mul_one]
   315	    exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply _
   316	  · have hrev : Fin.rev i ≠ line.direction := by
   317	      intro h
   318	      apply hi
   319	      rw [← h, Fin.rev_rev]
   320	    simp [hi, hrev, coordinateDirection]
   321	
   322	/-- Decoding a diagonal-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar
   323	along the decoded direct direction. -/
   324	theorem ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   325	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   326	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   327	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   328	    ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
   329	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   330	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t • ldtPointToDirect D line.direction := by
   331	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   332	  funext i
   333	  change decodeScalar
   334	      (addCoord (line.base (Fin.rev i))
   335	        (mulCoord t (line.direction (Fin.rev i)))) =
   336	    decodeScalar (line.base (Fin.rev i)) +
   337	      decodeScalar t * decodeScalar (line.direction (Fin.rev i))
   338	  simp [addCoord, mulCoord]
   339	
   340	/-- Canonical direct axis questions do not depend on the chosen base point of
   341	the mature line. -/
   342	theorem directAxisQuestionOf_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   343	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   344	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   345	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   346	    directAxisQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) = directAxisQuestionOf D line := by
   347	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   348	  simp only [directAxisQuestionOf, AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt_direction]
   349	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase, lineRepMap_add_smul]
   350	
   351	/-- Canonical direct diagonal questions do not depend on the chosen base point
   352	of the mature line; the leading index depends only on the direction. -/
   353	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   354	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   355	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   356	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   357	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   358	      directDiagonalQuestionOf D line := by
   359	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   360	  simp only [directDiagonalQuestionOf, DiagonalLine.rebaseAt]
   361	  have hrebase := ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase D line t
   362	  change ldtPointToDirect D (line.pointAt t) =
   363	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   364	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t • ldtPointToDirect D line.direction at hrebase
   365	  rw [hrebase, lineRepMap_add_smul]
   366	
   367	/-- The fixed scalar coding transports field addition to mature coordinate
   368	addition. -/
   369	theorem directScalarEquiv_add (D : DirectLdParams)
   370	    (x y : DirectScalarQ D) :
   371	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   372	    directScalarEquiv D (x + y) =
   373	      addCoord (directScalarEquiv D x) (directScalarEquiv D y) := by
   374	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   375	  change FieldModel.equiv (x + y) =
   376	    FieldModel.equiv
   377	      (FieldModel.equiv.symm (FieldModel.equiv x) +
   378	        FieldModel.equiv.symm (FieldModel.equiv y))
   379	  rw [FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply, FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply]
   380	
   381	private theorem coordinateDirection_ne_zero
   382	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
   383	    (coordinateDirection i : Fin m → K) ≠ 0 := by
   384	  intro h
   385	  have hi := congrFun h i
   386	  simp [coordinateDirection] at hi
   387	
   388	/-- Canonical rebase parameter for a mature axis-parallel line. -/
   389	noncomputable def directAxisRebaseParameter (D : DirectLdParams)
   390	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectScalarQ D :=
   391	  directLineRepParameter (coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction))
   392	    (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)
   393	
   394	/-- Canonical rebase parameter for a mature diagonal line. -/
   395	noncomputable def directDiagonalRebaseParameter (D : DirectLdParams)
   396	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectScalarQ D :=
   397	  directLineRepParameter (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction)
   398	    (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)
   399	
   400	/-- Axis-line canonical parameters add under mature rebasing. -/

401	theorem directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   402	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   403	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   404	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   405	    directAxisRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   406	      directAxisRebaseParameter D line + (directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
   407	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   408	  unfold directAxisRebaseParameter
   409	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase]
   410	  exact directLineRepParameter_add_smul
   411	    (coordinateDirection_ne_zero (Fin.rev line.direction)) _
   412	
   413	/-- Nonzero diagonal-line canonical parameters add under mature rebasing. -/
   414	theorem directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   415	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   416	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters)
   417	    (hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction ≠ 0) :
   418	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   419	    directDiagonalRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   420	      directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line + (directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
   421	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   422	  unfold directDiagonalRebaseParameter
   423	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase]
   424	  exact directLineRepParameter_add_smul hdir _

   426	/-! ## Reading direct answers as mature answers -/
   427	
   428	/-- The constant diagonal-line answer with the given direct value. -/
   429	noncomputable def constantDiagonalAnswer (D : DirectLdParams)
   430	    (x : DirectScalarQ D) :
   431	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   432	    DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   433	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   434	  exact { poly := Polynomial.C x
   435	          degreeBounded := by simp }
   436	
   437	/-- Constant answers are fixed by every reparametrization. -/
   438	theorem constantDiagonalAnswer_reparamAt (D : DirectLdParams)
   439	    (x : DirectScalarQ D) (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   440	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   441	    DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt (constantDiagonalAnswer D x) t =
   442	      constantDiagonalAnswer D x := by
   443	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   444	  apply DiagonalLinePolynomial.ext
   445	  simp [constantDiagonalAnswer, DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt]
   446	
   447	/-- A constant answer evaluates to its value at every parameter. -/
   448	theorem constantDiagonalAnswer_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
   449	    (x : DirectScalarQ D) (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   450	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   451	    constantDiagonalAnswer D x t = directScalarEquiv D x := by
   452	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   453	  change encodeScalar ((Polynomial.C x).eval (decodeScalar t)) =
   454	    directScalarEquiv D x
   455	  rw [Polynomial.eval_C]
   456	  rfl
   457	
   458	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct point answer. -/
   459	noncomputable def directPointAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k) :
   460	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   461	    DirectLdAnswer D → Fq D.toLDTParameters := by
   462	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   463	  intro answer
   464	  exact match answer with
   465	    | .pointVals a => directScalarEquiv D (a r)
   466	    | .alinePolys _ => directScalarEquiv D 0
   467	    | .dlinePolys _ => directScalarEquiv D 0
   468	
   469	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct axis-line answer and
   470	rebase its polynomial from the canonical direct line to the mature line. -/
   471	noncomputable def directAxisAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   472	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   473	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   474	    DirectLdAnswer D → AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   475	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   476	  intro answer
   477	  exact match answer with
   478	    | .alinePolys a => AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt
   479	        (directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r))
   480	        (directScalarEquiv D (directAxisRebaseParameter D line))
   481	    | .pointVals _ => default
   482	    | .dlinePolys _ => default
   483	
   484	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct diagonal-line answer.  For
   485	a nonzero direction the polynomial is rebased from the canonical direct line
   486	to the mature line.  A zero direction is the singleton line through its base,
   487	where the direct predicate accepts an answer exactly when its polynomial
   488	function is constant with the point's value (`rem:ld-win-zero-direction`);
   489	the answer is read as the constant polynomial carrying its value at the base
   490	point, which is fixed by every reparametrization.  Wrong-form answers are
   491	sent to the default polynomial. -/
   492	noncomputable def directDiagonalAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   493	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   494	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   495	    DirectLdAnswer D → DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   496	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   497	  classical
   498	  intro answer
   499	  exact match answer with
   500	    | .dlinePolys a =>
   501	        if ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0 then
   502	          constantDiagonalAnswer D (evalCoefficient (a r) 0)
   503	        else
   504	          DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt (directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r))
   505	            (directScalarEquiv D (directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line))
   506	    | .pointVals _ => default
   507	    | .alinePolys _ => default
   508	
   509	/-- Axis answer readout is covariant under mature line rebasing. -/
   510	theorem directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   511	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   512	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) :
   513	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   514	    directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   515	      AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt (directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
   516	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   517	  cases answer with
   518	  | pointVals a => simp [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   519	  | dlinePolys a => simp [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   520	  | alinePolys a =>
   521	      simp only [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   522	      rw [directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase, directScalarEquiv_add]
   523	      rw [(directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
   524	      exact (AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
   525	        (directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm
   526	
   527	/-- Diagonal answer readout is covariant under mature line rebasing, including
   528	the constant zero-direction convention. -/
   529	theorem directDiagonalAnswerReadout_rebase (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   530	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   531	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) :
   532	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   533	    directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   534	      DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt
   535	        (directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
   536	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   537	  cases answer with
   538	  | pointVals a => simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout]
   539	  | alinePolys a => simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout]
   540	  | dlinePolys a =>
   541	      by_cases hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0
   542	      · have hrebase : ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction = 0 := by
   543	          simpa [DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
   544	        simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase,
   545	          constantDiagonalAnswer_reparamAt]
   546	      · have hrebase : ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction ≠ 0 := by
   547	          simpa [DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
   548	        simp only [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase, ↓reduceIte]
   549	        rw [directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase D line t hdir,
   550	          directScalarEquiv_add, (directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
   551	        exact (DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
   552	          (directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm
   553	
   554	end

   556	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

   761	/-- Paper-faithful two-space projective strategy data.
   762	
   763	This matches the paper's `def:general-projective-strategy`
   764	(`test_definition.tex`, lines 98--115): Alice's and Bob's measurements act on
   765	separate local carriers `ιA` and `ιB`, and the bipartite state lives on
   766	`ιA × ιB` without a built-in swap symmetry.
   767	
   768	The `isNormalized` field records that the bipartite state's density operator
   769	has normalized trace `1`.
   770	
   771	The four covariance conditions express that the line-indexed projectors
   772	descend from chosen affine parametrizations to geometric lines; transport and
   773	zero-coordinate evaluation are equivalent consequences. -/
   774	structure ProjStrat (params : Parameters) [FieldModel params.q]
   775	    (ιA : Type*) [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
   776	    (ιB : Type*) [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB] where
   777	  /-- Bipartite state on the tensor product of Alice's and Bob's local carriers. -/
   778	  state : QuantumState (ιA × ιB)
   779	  /-- The bipartite state's density operator is trace-normalized. -/
   780	  isNormalized : state.IsNormalized
   781	  /-- Alice's point-measurement family, acting on `ιA`. -/
   782	  pointMeasurementA : IdxProjMeas (Point params) (Fq params) ιA
   783	  /-- Alice's axis-parallel-line measurement family, acting on `ιA`. -/
   784	  axisParallelMeasurementA :
   785	    IdxProjMeas (AxisParallelLine params) (AxisLinePolynomial params) ιA
   786	  /-- Alice's axis-parallel measurement is covariant under line rebasing. -/
   787	  axisParallelReparamInvariantA :
   788	    AxisParallelMeasurementReparamInvariant params axisParallelMeasurementA
   789	  /-- Alice's diagonal-line measurement family, acting on `ιA`. -/
   790	  diagonalMeasurementA :
   791	    IdxProjMeas (DiagonalLine params) (DiagonalLinePolynomial params) ιA
   792	  /-- Alice's diagonal measurement is covariant under line rebasing. -/
   793	  diagonalReparamInvariantA :
   794	    DiagonalMeasurementReparamInvariant params diagonalMeasurementA
   795	  /-- Bob's point-measurement family, acting on `ιB`. -/
   796	  pointMeasurementB : IdxProjMeas (Point params) (Fq params) ιB
   797	  /-- Bob's axis-parallel-line measurement family, acting on `ιB`. -/
   798	  axisParallelMeasurementB :
   799	    IdxProjMeas (AxisParallelLine params) (AxisLinePolynomial params) ιB
   800	  /-- Bob's axis-parallel measurement is covariant under line rebasing. -/
   801	  axisParallelReparamInvariantB :
   802	    AxisParallelMeasurementReparamInvariant params axisParallelMeasurementB
   803	  /-- Bob's diagonal-line measurement family, acting on `ιB`. -/
   804	  diagonalMeasurementB :
   805	    IdxProjMeas (DiagonalLine params) (DiagonalLinePolynomial params) ιB
   806	  /-- Bob's diagonal measurement is covariant under line rebasing. -/
   807	  diagonalReparamInvariantB :
   808	    DiagonalMeasurementReparamInvariant params diagonalMeasurementB

500	with the usual unit-vector condition (`⟨ψ|ψ⟩ = 1`) used in the paper.
   501	Bundling normalization with the strategy avoids threading a
   502	`state.IsNormalized` hypothesis through every downstream consumer
   503	(pasting cascade, `triangleSub` users, self-improvement helpers). -/
   504	structure SymStrat (params : Parameters) [FieldModel params.q]
   505	    (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] where
   506	  state : QuantumState (ι × ι)  -- bipartite state on ℋ ⊗ ℋ
   507	  permInvState : PermInvState state
   508	  densityFixed : swapDensity state.density = state.density
   509	  isNormalized : state.IsNormalized
   510	  pointMeasurement : IdxProjMeas (Point params) (Fq params) ι
   511	  axisParallelMeasurement : AxisParallelCovariantMeasurement params ι
   512	  diagonalMeasurement : DiagonalCovariantMeasurement params ι
   513	
   514	-- NOTE: no global `Inhabited` instance for `SymStrat`; constructing default
   515	-- projective measurement families is non-canonical and requires additional
   516	-- assumptions on outcome types.
   517	
   518	/-- Encoded samples `(u, i)` for the axis-parallel lines test.
   519	The paper samples a random point `u ∈ F_q^m` and a coordinate
   520	`i ∈ {1, …, m}`. In Lean, `Fin params.m` represents the 0-indexed
   521	coordinates `{0, …, m - 1}`, corresponding to the paper's 1-indexed
   522	choice. The sample forms the axis-parallel line through `u` in that
   523	coordinate direction. -/
   524	abbrev AxisParallelTestSample (params : Parameters) :=
   525	  Point params × Fin params.m
   526	
   527	/-- Extend restricted direction coordinates to a full direction vector.
   528	For restriction index `j` (0-indexed), the first `j + 1` coordinates
   529	are the given free coordinates and the remaining are zero.
   530	This matches the paper's convention that `v` has its last `m − i`
   531	coordinates zero, where `i = j + 1`. -/
   532	def extendRestrictedDirection {params : Parameters}
   533	    [FieldModel params.q] (j : Fin params.m)
   534	    (freeCoords : Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq params) :
   535	    Point params :=
   536	  fun k =>
   537	    if h : k.val ≤ j.val then
   538	      freeCoords ⟨k.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h⟩
   539	    else zeroCoord
   540	
   541	/-- Encoded samples `(u, freeCoords)` for the `j`-restricted diagonal

    11	## References
    12

    14	`def:tensor-product-strategy`, and `def:tensor-product-value` in
    15	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:47-82` and `8-26`.

    26	/--
    27	A finite two-player one-round game with a probability distribution on question
    28	pairs and a Boolean decision predicate.  This is `def:game` in

    30	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:10-24`.

    32	structure Game where
    33	  QuestionA : Type
    34	  QuestionB : Type
    35	  AnswerA : Type
    36	  AnswerB : Type
    37	  [questionAFintype : Fintype QuestionA]
    38	  [questionBFintype : Fintype QuestionB]
    39	  [answerAFintype : Fintype AnswerA]
    40	  [answerBFintype : Fintype AnswerB]
    41	  [questionADecidableEq : DecidableEq QuestionA]
    42	  [questionBDecidableEq : DecidableEq QuestionB]
    43	  [answerADecidableEq : DecidableEq AnswerA]
    44	  [answerBDecidableEq : DecidableEq AnswerB]
    45	  μ : Distribution (QuestionA × QuestionB)

    51	  Game.questionBDecidableEq Game.answerADecidableEq Game.answerBDecidableEq
    52	
    53	/--
    54	The marginal of a joint POVM obtained by post-processing its answer pair.  This
    55	is the POVM convention of `def:povm-conventions` in
    56	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`; the post-processing operation
    57	is the already formalized `Measurement.postprocess`, with paper origin
    58	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`.

    60	noncomputable def marginalLeft {α β d : Type*}
    61	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    62	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    63	    (M : Measurement (α × β) d) : Measurement α d :=
    64	  M.postprocess Prod.fst
    65	
    66	/-- The right marginal of a joint POVM, obtained using `Prod.snd` in
    67	`def:povm-conventions`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`,
    68	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`.
    69	-/

    71	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    72	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    73	    (M : Measurement (α × β) d) : Measurement β d :=
    74	  M.postprocess Prod.snd

    76	/-- Projectivity of every effect in a POVM (`def:povm-conventions`, blueprint
    77	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`; paper origin
    78	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:68-72`). -/

    83	/--
    84	The tensor-product strategy of `def:tensor-product-strategy` in
    85	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69` (paper origin
    86	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`).

    88	structure Strategy (G : Game) where
    89	  ιA : Type
    90	  ιB : Type
    91	  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA]
    92	  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB]
    93	  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA]
    94	  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB]
    95	  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)
    96	  ψ_norm : ‖ψ‖ = 1
    97	  A : G.QuestionA → Measurement G.AnswerA ιA
    98	  B : G.QuestionB → Measurement G.AnswerB ιB
    99	
   100	attribute [instance] Strategy.ιAFintype Strategy.ιBFintype
   101	  Strategy.ιADecidableEq Strategy.ιBDecidableEq
   102	
   103	/-- The rectangular tensor placement used in strategy probabilities.  This is
   104	the finite-matrix realization of `def:tensor-product-strategy`, blueprint
   105	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`; paper origin
   106	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`.
   107	-/
   108	def heteroKron {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) : Op (ιA × ιB) :=
   109	  Matrix.kronecker A B
   110	
   111	/- The Euclidean linear map is the shared action used by the value and distance
   112	functionals.  Keeping it at the Euclidean-space level avoids accidentally
   113	using the function-space supremum norm of `Matrix.mulVec`. -/
   114	/-- Apply a finite matrix to a Euclidean-space state.  This is the Hilbert-space
   115	action underlying `def:tensor-product-value`, paper
   116	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-271`. -/
   117	noncomputable def applyOperatorToState {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   118	    (M : Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι :=
   119	  Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ
   120	
   121	/-- The Born weight of an answer pair for a strategy.  Lean-only support for
   122	`def:tensor-product-value`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, paper
   123	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-48`. -/
   124	noncomputable def outcomeWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   125	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) : ℝ :=
   126	  let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
   127	    heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)
   128	  let acted := applyOperatorToState M S.ψ
   129	  (inner ℂ S.ψ acted).re
   130	
   131	/-- Every answer-pair Born weight is nonnegative.  This is formalization-only
   132	support for the probability expression in `def:tensor-product-value`. -/
   133	theorem outcomeWeight_nonneg {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   134	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) :
   135	    0 ≤ outcomeWeight S x y a b := by
   136	  unfold outcomeWeight applyOperatorToState heteroKron
   137	  exact
   138	    (Matrix.isPositive_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr
   139	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
   140	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.A x).pos a) ((S.B y).pos b)))).re_inner_nonneg_right S.ψ
   141	
   142	/-- The Born weights of all answer pairs at fixed questions sum to one.  This
   143	is formalization-only support for the POVM normalization implicit in
   144	`def:tensor-product-value`. -/
   145	theorem outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   146	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) :
   147	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b = 1 := by
   148	  have hsum :
   149	      (∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   150	        heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) =
   151	          (1 : Op (S.ιA × S.ιB)) := by
   152	    ext i j
   153	    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   154	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   155	    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
   156	    rw [show (∑ a : G.AnswerA, (S.A x).effect a i.1 j.1) =
   157	        (1 : Op S.ιA) i.1 j.1 by
   158	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.A x).sum_eq_one i.1) j.1]
   159	    rw [show (∑ b : G.AnswerB, (S.B y).effect b i.2 j.2) =
   160	        (1 : Op S.ιB) i.2 j.2 by
   161	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.B y).sum_eq_one i.2) j.2]
   162	    exact congrFun (congrFun
   163	      (Matrix.one_kronecker_one (m := S.ιA) (n := S.ιB) (α := ℂ)) i) j
   164	  calc
   165	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b =
   166	        (inner ℂ S.ψ
   167	          (applyOperatorToState
   168	            (∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   169	              heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   170	          simp [outcomeWeight, applyOperatorToState]
   171	    _ = (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState 1 S.ψ)).re := by rw [hsum]
   172	    _ = 1 := by
   173	      simp [applyOperatorToState, S.ψ_norm]
   174

   179	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-57`.
   180	-/

    14	/-- A PSD density matrix indexed by `ι`.
    15	
    16	There is intentionally no global `Inhabited` instance: the zero matrix is PSD but
    17	not a physical state of unit trace, so an ambient default would silently
    18	trivialize later statements. Use `IsNormalized` to additionally require
    19	`τ(ρ) = 1`.
    20	
    21	This remains the ambient state space for the current LDT development: strategy
    22	packages in `LDT/Test/StrategyCore.lean`, the SWAP-symmetry API `PermInvState`,
    23	and the expectation-value lemmas in `LDT/Basic/OperatorExpectations.lean` are all
    24	stated for arbitrary density matrices, not only pure states. -/
    25	structure QuantumState (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] where
    26	  density : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι := 0
    27	  density_psd : 0 ≤ density := by positivity
    28	
    29	/-- Unit normalized trace for the concrete matrix carried by a state. -/
    30	def QuantumState.IsNormalized {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    31	    (ψ : QuantumState ι) : Prop :=
    32	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ψ.density = 1
    33	
    34	/-- A normalized state has a nonempty carrier: if the carrier were empty, the
    35	trace would vanish and `normalizedTrace = 0 / 0 = 0`, contradicting `= 1`. -/
    36	theorem QuantumState.IsNormalized.nonempty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    37	    {ψ : QuantumState ι} (hψ : ψ.IsNormalized) : Nonempty ι := by
    38	  by_contra h
    39	  rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
    40	  letI := h
    41	  rw [QuantumState.IsNormalized] at hψ
    42	  have hzero : MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ψ.density = 0 := by
    43	    simp [MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace]
    44	  exact zero_ne_one (hzero.symm.trans hψ)
    45	
    46	/-- The scaled rank-one density matrix attached to a state vector.
    47	
    48	Because this development uses the normalized trace `τ(A) = tr(A) / dim`, the
    49	quantum state represented by a unit vector `ψ` is `dim · |ψ⟩⟨ψ|` rather than the
    50	raw projector `|ψ⟩⟨ψ|`. This scaling makes `τ(ρ) = 1` and keeps `ev` aligned
    51	with the paper's bra-ket expectations. -/
    52	noncomputable def pureDensity {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    53	    (ψ : ι → ℂ) : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
    54	  (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) • Matrix.vecMulVec ψ (star ψ)
    55	
    56	/-- Swap the two tensor coordinates of a bipartite state vector. -/
    57	def swapVector {ι : Type*} (ψ : ι × ι → ℂ) : ι × ι → ℂ :=
    58	  fun ij => ψ (ij.2, ij.1)
    59	
    60	/-- A pure-state witness as a unit vector in the ambient finite Hilbert space.
    61	
    62	The associated density matrix is `pureDensity ψ.vector = dim · |ψ⟩⟨ψ|`, so that
    63	coercing to `QuantumState` preserves the paper's scalar `⟨ψ|X|ψ⟩` formulas
    64	despite our use of the normalized trace. -/
    65	structure PureState (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] where
    66	  vector : ι → ℂ
    67	  unit : star vector ⬝ᵥ vector = 1

    71	/-- The coordinate-basis vector has unit self-dot product. -/
    72	private theorem basis_unit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    73	    (i : ι) :
    74	    star (fun j => if j = i then (1 : ℂ) else 0) ⬝ᵥ
    75	        (fun j => if j = i then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = 1 := by
    76	  rw [dotProduct]
    77	  simp

    79	/-- The coordinate-basis pure state at a distinguished basis vector. -/
    80	noncomputable def basis {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    81	    (i : ι) : PureState ι where
    82	  vector := fun j => if j = i then 1 else 0
    83	  unit := basis_unit i
    84	
    85	/-- The density matrix represented by a pure-state witness. -/
    86	noncomputable def density {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    87	    (ψ : PureState ι) : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
    88	  pureDensity ψ.vector

    90	theorem density_psd {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    91	    (ψ : PureState ι) :
    92	    0 ≤ ψ.density := by
    93	  refine Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr ?_
    94	  exact (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star ψ.vector).smul
    95	    (by positivity : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℂ))
    96	
    97	noncomputable def toQuantumState {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    98	    (ψ : PureState ι) : QuantumState ι where
    99	  density := ψ.density

   102	noncomputable instance {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] :
   103	    Coe (PureState ι) (QuantumState ι) where
   104	  coe := toQuantumState

   106	@[simp] theorem coe_density {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   107	    (ψ : PureState ι) :
   108	    (ψ : QuantumState ι).density = ψ.density := rfl

   110	theorem normalizedTrace_density {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   111	    (ψ : PureState ι) :
   112	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ψ.density = 1 := by
   113	  have hcard : (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
   114	  unfold density pureDensity MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
   115	  rw [Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm, ψ.unit]
   116	  change ((Fintype.card ι : ℂ) * 1) / (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) = 1
   117	  rw [mul_one, div_self hcard]

   119	theorem toQuantumState_isNormalized {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]

   121	    (ψ : QuantumState ι).IsNormalized := by

   123	
   124	theorem normalizedTrace_density_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   125	    (ψ : PureState ι) (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
   126	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ((ψ : QuantumState ι).density * X) =
   127	      star ψ.vector ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ ψ.vector) := by
   128	  have hcard : (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
   129	  calc
   130	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ((ψ : QuantumState ι).density * X)
   131	      = MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (X * (ψ : QuantumState ι).density) := by
   132	          rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace_mul_comm]
   133	    _ = MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (X * ψ.density) := by rfl
   134	    _ = MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
   135	          ((Fintype.card ι : ℂ) • (X * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ.vector (star ψ.vector))) := by
   136	          simp [density, pureDensity]
   137	    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) *
   138	          MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (X * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ.vector (star ψ.vector)) := by
   139	          rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace_smul]
   140	    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) *
   141	          (((X * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ.vector (star ψ.vector)).trace) /
   142	            (Fintype.card ι : ℂ)) := by
   143	          simp [MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace]
   144	    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) *
   145	          (((Matrix.vecMulVec (X *ᵥ ψ.vector) (star ψ.vector)).trace) /
   146	            (Fintype.card ι : ℂ)) := by
   147	          rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec]
   148	    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) *
   149	          (((X *ᵥ ψ.vector) ⬝ᵥ star ψ.vector) / (Fintype.card ι : ℂ)) := by

   288	noncomputable def tauObservable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

   290	  fun x y =>
   291	    ∏ i : ι,

   296	/--
   297	The EPR vector on a finite label space.  Blueprint `def:EPR`,
   298	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:513-523`; paper origin
   299	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:946-955`.
   300	-/
   301	noncomputable def eprState (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] :
   302	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (V × V) :=
   303	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (V × V) ℂ).symm
   304	    (fun p : V × V =>
   305	      if p.1 = p.2 then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0)

   307	/-- The EPR vector is normalized on a nonempty finite carrier; see
   308	`def:EPR`, `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:946-955`. -/
   309	theorem eprState_norm (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] :
   310	    ‖eprState V‖ = 1 := by
   311	  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one).mp
   312	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]

   314	    (∑ p : V × V,
   315	      ‖if p.1 = p.2 then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0‖ ^ 2) =
   316	      1 ^ 2

   319	  calc
   320	    ∑ x : V, ∑ y : V,
   321	        ‖if x = y then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0‖ ^ 2 =

     4	# Finite-dimensional state transformations
     5	
     6	This file defines the tensor and reindexing operations used for strategy
     7	distance, Magic Square rigidity, and the qudit-to-qubit isomorphism. See
     8	blueprint chapters 11--13 and the declaration-level references below.

    10	
    11	open scoped Matrix
    12	
    13	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    14	
    15	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    16	
    17	/-- Conjugation by the local isometries in `thm:ms-rigidity` and
    18	`lem:pauli-binary`; blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244` and
    19	`ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:710-741`, paper
    20	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652` and
    21	`04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1208`. -/
    22	noncomputable def conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type*}
    23	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
    24	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι')
    25	    (M : Op ι) : Op ι' :=
    26	  let U : Matrix ι' ι ℂ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm φ.toLinearMap
    27	  U * M * Uᴴ
    28	
    29	/-- Coordinate transport used by `def:strategy-distance`, blueprint
    30	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    31	noncomputable def reindexState {ι ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    32	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι')
    33	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι' :=
    34	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι' ℂ).symm
    35	    (fun j => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ ψ) (e.symm j))
    36	
    37	/-- Apply the two independent local isometries of `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    38	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    39	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    40	noncomputable def isometryTensor
    41	    {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}
    42	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    43	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    44	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    45	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    46	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
    47	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB) :=
    48	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (κA × κB) ℂ).symm
    49	    (fun p =>
    50	      ∑ i : ιA, ∑ j : ιB,
    51	        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κA ℂ)
    52	            (φA ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιA ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1))) p.1) *
    53	          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κB ℂ)
    54	            (φB ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιB ℂ).symm (Pi.single j 1))) p.2) *
    55	          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (ιA × ιB) ℂ) ψ (i, j)))
    56	
    57	/-- Coordinate tensor used in the ideal state of `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    58	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    59	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    60	noncomputable def vecTensor {ι κ : Type*}
    61	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    62	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
    63	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × κ) :=
    64	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι × κ) ℂ).symm
    65	    (fun p => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ u) p.1 * (EuclideanSpace.equiv κ ℂ v) p.2)
    66	
    67	/-- Operator transport used by `def:strategy-distance`, blueprint
    68	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    69	def reindexOp {ι ι' : Type*} (e : ι ≃ ι') (M : Op ι') : Op ι :=
    70	  (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm) M
    71	
    72	/-- Four-factor tensor shuffle used by `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    73	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    74	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    75	def prodShuffle {α β γ δ : Type*} :
    76	    (α × β) × (γ × δ) ≃ (α × γ) × (β × δ) where
    77	  toFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
    78	  invFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
    79	  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    80	  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    81	
    82	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     6	# Seed-fiber dilation for the directly indexed low-degree game
     7	
     8	This module dilates a seed-indexed low-degree strategy by a maximally

    10	arbitrary dependence on the seed within each `chiIndex` fiber.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
    15	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`

    27	/-! ## Projective block measurements -/
    28	
    29	/-- Relabel a matrix measurement along an equivalence of outcome alphabets. -/
    30	noncomputable def matrixMeasurementTransport
    31	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    32	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    33	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    34	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement beta iota :=
    35	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    36	    (fun b => M.effect (e.symm b))
    37	    (fun b => M.pos (e.symm b))
    38	    (by
    39	      calc
    40	        ∑ b, M.effect (e.symm b) = ∑ a, M.effect a :=
    41	          Equiv.sum_comp e.symm M.effect
    42	        _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one)
    43	
    44	@[simp] theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_effect
    45	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    46	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    47	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    48	    (b : beta) :
    49	    (matrixMeasurementTransport e M).effect b = M.effect (e.symm b) :=
    50	  rfl
    51	
    52	/-- Relabeling a projective matrix measurement preserves projectivity. -/
    53	theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
    54	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    55	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    56	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    57	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    58	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (matrixMeasurementTransport e M) :=
    59	  fun b => hM (e.symm b)
    60	
    61	/-- Assemble a family of matrix measurements as diagonal blocks indexed by a
    62	finite classical register. -/
    63	noncomputable def blockDiagonalMeasurement
    64	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    65	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    66	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    67	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    68	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block) :=
    69	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    70	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal fun r => (M r).effect a)
    71	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal_nonneg
    72	      (fun r => (M r).effect a) (fun r => (M r).pos a))
    73	    (by
    74	      ext ⟨i, r⟩ ⟨j, s⟩
    75	      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
    76	      by_cases hrs : r = s
    77	      · subst s
    78	        simp only [if_pos]
    79	        calc
    80	          ∑ x, (M r).effect x i j = (1 : Matrix iota iota ℂ) i j :=
    81	            by
    82	              simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using
    83	                congrFun (congrFun (M r).sum_eq_one i) j
    84	          _ = (1 : Matrix (iota × block) (iota × block) ℂ)
    85	              (i, r) (j, r) := by
    86	                change (if i = j then 1 else 0) =
    87	                  (if (i, r) = (j, r) then 1 else 0)
    88	                simp
    89	      · simp [hrs])
    90	
    91	@[simp] theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_effect
    92	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    93	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    94	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    95	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    96	    (a : alpha) :
    97	    (blockDiagonalMeasurement M).effect a =
    98	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) :=
    99	  rfl
   100	
   101	/-- A block-diagonal family of projective measurements is projective. -/
   102	theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   103	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
   104	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   105	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
   106	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   107	    (hM : ∀ r, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M r)) :
   108	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (blockDiagonalMeasurement M) := by
   109	  intro a
   110	  constructor
   111	  · change Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) *
   112	        Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) =
   113	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   114	    rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
   115	    congr 1
   116	    funext r
   117	    exact (hM r a).isIdempotentElem.eq
   118	  · change (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a))ᴴ =
   119	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   120	    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose]
   121	    congr 1
   122	    funext r
   123	    exact (hM r a).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq

   125	/-! ## The correlated residue state -/
   126	
   127	/-- The normalized maximally correlated state on the common seed-fiber
   128	residue. -/
   129	noncomputable def seedResidueAncilla (L : LdParams) :
   130	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   131	      (Fin (L.q / L.m) × Fin (L.q / L.m)) := by
   132	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   133	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   134	  exact eprState (Fin (L.q / L.m))

   136	/-- The seed-residue ancilla has unit norm. -/
   137	theorem seedResidueAncilla_norm (L : LdParams) :
   138	    ‖seedResidueAncilla L‖ = 1 := by
   139	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   140	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   141	  exact eprState_norm (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   142	
   143	/-- Reindexing Euclidean coordinates along an equivalence preserves norm. -/
   144	theorem reindexState_norm_eq
   145	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   146	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   147	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   148	    (e : iota ≃ kappa) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
   149	    ‖reindexState e psi‖ = ‖psi‖ := by
   150	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
   151	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   152	  change (∑ j : kappa, ‖psi (e.symm j)‖ ^ 2) = ∑ i : iota, ‖psi i‖ ^ 2
   153	  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ‖psi i‖ ^ 2)
   154	
   155	/-- The coordinate tensor of two Euclidean vectors has the product norm. -/
   156	theorem vecTensor_norm_eq
   157	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   158	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   159	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   160	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ kappa) :
   161	    ‖vecTensor u v‖ = ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := by
   162	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
   163	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, mul_pow, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
   164	    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   165	  change (∑ p : iota × kappa, ‖u p.1 * v p.2‖ ^ 2) =
   166	    (∑ i : iota, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j : kappa, ‖v j‖ ^ 2
   167	  simp only [norm_mul, mul_pow]
   168	  rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_mul]
   169	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   170	  intro i hi
   171	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   172	
   173	/-- Tensor the original strategy state with the maximally correlated residue
   174	state and shuffle the factors back into the two local carriers. -/
   175	noncomputable def seedFiberLiftedState
   176	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   177	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   178	      ((S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)) × (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :=
   179	  reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor S.ψ (seedResidueAncilla L))
   180	
   181	/-- The correlated seed-fiber lift preserves normalization of the strategy
   182	state. -/
   183	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_norm
   184	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   185	    ‖seedFiberLiftedState S L‖ = 1 := by
   186	  rw [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq,
   187	    S.ψ_norm, seedResidueAncilla_norm, one_mul]

   189	/-! ## From the seed-indexed game to the direct game -/
   190	
   191	/-- The seed-indexed question selected in one residue block of a direct

   194	noncomputable def seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)

   196	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : LdQuestion L :=
   197	  (q.1, ldCL L q.1 (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L q.2 residue))
   198	
   199	/-- Dilate a strategy for the seed-indexed low-degree game to the directly
   200	indexed game.  The two local carriers receive correlated copies of the seed
   201	residue, and each measurement is block diagonal in that residue. -/
   202	noncomputable def ldStrategyToDirect (L : LdParams)
   203	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) : Strategy (directLdGame L.toDirectLdParams) where
   204	  ιA := S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   205	  ιB := S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m)

   209	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   210	      (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   211	  B q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   212	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   213	      (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue))

   215	/-- Projectivity is preserved by the correlated seed-fiber dilation. -/
   216	theorem ldStrategyToDirect_isProjective (L : LdParams)
   217	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) (hS : S.IsProjective) :
   218	    (ldStrategyToDirect L S).IsProjective := by
   219	  constructor
   220	  · intro q
   221	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   222	    intro residue
   223	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   224	    exact hS.1 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   225	  · intro q
   226	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   227	    intro residue
   228	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   229	    exact hS.2 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)

   234	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   235	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).A q).effect answer =
   236	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   237	        (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   238	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   239	  rfl

   244	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :

   251	/-- A direct question reconstructed in a residue block parses back to its
   252	canonical direct form. -/
   253	theorem parse_seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   254	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   255	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   256	    parseLdQuestion L (seededLdQuestion L q residue) =
   257	      (q.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams q.1 q.2) := by
   258	  exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L q.1 q.2 residue

   260	/-- Coordinate formula for the correlated residue lift. -/
   261	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_apply
   262	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   263	    (i : S.ιA) (j : S.ιB)
   264	    (r s : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   265	    seedFiberLiftedState S L ((i, r), (j, s)) =
   266	      if r = s then
   267	        S.ψ (i, j) * (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹
   268	      else 0 := by
   269	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   270	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   271	  simp [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState, vecTensor, seedResidueAncilla,
   272	    eprState, prodShuffle]

     4	/-!
     5	# Strategy transport for the directly indexed low-degree game
     6	
     7	This module reads one coordinate of a projective directly indexed strategy as
     8	a two-space mature low individual degree strategy.  The question and answer
     9	transport of `Transport.Questions` supplies the canonical direct question of
    10	every mature line, with the reversed coordinate order and the leading index
    11	of the decoded diagonal direction, together with answer readouts that are
    12	covariant under line rebasing; this establishes all four covariance
    13	conditions of `ProjStrat`.  The module also records exact Born-weight
    14	formulas for both directions of strategy transport.
    15	
    16	## References
    17	
    18	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
    19	- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-151`
    20	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    21	-/

    34	/-- Regard a matrix-valued projective measurement as a projective measurement
    35	in the mature LDT interface. -/
    36	noncomputable def matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas
    37	    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    38	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    39	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    40	    MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas alpha iota where
    41	  toMeasurement := {
    42	    toSubMeas := {
    43	      outcome := M.effect
    44	      total := 1
    45	      outcome_pos := M.pos
    46	      sum_eq_total := M.sum_eq_one
    47	      total_le_one := le_rfl
    48	    }
    49	    total_eq_one := rfl
    50	  }
    51	  proj a := (hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq

    56	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) (a : alpha) :
    57	    (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas M hM).outcome a = M.effect a :=

   113	/-- The coordinate axis-line family is independent of the chosen affine
   114	parametrization of a mature line. -/
   115	theorem directCoordinateAxisMeasurement_reparam
   116	    (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   117	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   118	    (M : DirectLdQuestion D →
   119	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
   120	    (hM : ∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
   121	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   122	    AxisParallelMeasurementReparamInvariant D.toLDTParameters
   123	      (directCoordinateAxisMeasurement D r M hM) := by
   124	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   125	  classical
   126	  intro line t f
   127	  simp only [directCoordinateAxisMeasurement, ProjMeas.postprocess,
   128	    SubMeas.postprocess_outcome, matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome]
   129	  rw [directAxisQuestionOf_rebase]
   130	  have hfiber :
   131	      Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
   132	        directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   133	          AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt f t) =
   134	        Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
   135	          directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer = f) := by
   136	    ext answer
   137	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   138	    rw [directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase]
   139	    exact (AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAtEquiv t).injective.eq_iff
   140	  rw [hfiber]

   143	parametrization, including the zero-direction convention. -/
   144	theorem directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement_reparam
   145	    (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   146	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]

   150	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   151	    DiagonalMeasurementReparamInvariant D.toLDTParameters
   152	      (directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement D r M hM) := by
   153	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   154	  classical
   155	  intro line t f

   157	    SubMeas.postprocess_outcome, matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome]

   161	        directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   162	          DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt f t) =
   163	        Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
   164	          directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line answer = f) := by
   165	    ext answer
   166	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   167	    rw [directDiagonalAnswerReadout_rebase]
   168	    exact (DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAtEquiv t).injective.eq_iff

   204	/-- The complex Born amplitude of a vector and two local effects. -/

   209	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))

211	  inner ℂ psi (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron A B) psi)

   213	/-- The real Born quadratic form of a vector and two local effects. -/

   215	    {iotaA iotaB : Type*}
   216	    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
   217	    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
   218	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))

   222	/-- Public outcome-level Born weight for a finite game strategy. -/

   224	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)

   284	    {iotaA iotaB : Type*}
   285	    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
   286	    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
   287	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))

   294	private theorem vectorBornWeight_finset_sum_left
   295	    {alpha iotaA iotaB : Type*}
   296	    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
   297	    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
   298	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))
   299	    (s : Finset alpha) (A : alpha → Op iotaA) (B : Op iotaB) :
   300	    vectorBornWeight psi (∑ a ∈ s, A a) B =
   301	      ∑ a ∈ s, vectorBornWeight psi (A a) B := by
   302	  classical
   303	  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
   304	  | empty =>
   305	      simp [vectorBornWeight, vectorBornAmplitude_zero_left]
   306	  | @insert a s ha ih =>
   307	      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha,
   308	        vectorBornWeight_add_left, ih]

   311	    {beta iotaA iotaB : Type*}
   312	    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
   313	    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
   314	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))
   315	    (A : Op iotaA) (s : Finset beta) (B : beta → Op iotaB) :
   316	    vectorBornWeight psi A (∑ b ∈ s, B b) =
   317	      ∑ b ∈ s, vectorBornWeight psi A (B b) := by
   318	  classical
   319	  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
   320	  | empty =>
   321	      simp [vectorBornWeight, vectorBornAmplitude_zero_right]
   322	  | @insert b s hb ih =>
   323	      rw [Finset.sum_insert hb, Finset.sum_insert hb,
   324	        vectorBornWeight_add_right, ih]

   326	/-- Expectations in the density state associated with a strategy agree with
   327	the strategy's vector Born quadratic form. -/
   328	theorem strategyQuantumState_ev_eq_vectorBornWeight
   329	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (A : Op S.ιA) (B : Op S.ιB) :
   330	    ev (strategyQuantumState S) (opTensor A B) =
   331	      vectorBornWeight S.ψ A B := by
   332	  letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) := strategy_carrier_nonempty S
   333	  rw [show strategyQuantumState S =
   334	      PureState.toQuantumState (strategyPureState S) by
   335	        simp [strategyQuantumState],
   336	    PureState.ev_eq_re_inner]
   337	  unfold vectorBornWeight vectorBornAmplitude applyOperatorToState heteroKron opTensor
   338	  simp_rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
   339	  change (star S.ψ ⬝ᵥ
   340	      (Matrix.kronecker A B *ᵥ S.ψ)).re =
   341	    ((Matrix.kronecker A B *ᵥ S.ψ) ⬝ᵥ star S.ψ).re
   342	  rw [dotProduct_comm]

   344	/-- Postprocessing both local measurements gives the exact double sum of the
   345	original Born weights over the two answer fibers. -/
   346	theorem directPostprocessBornWeight
   347	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
   348	    (hS : S.IsProjective)
   349	    {alpha beta : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
   350	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta]
   351	    (x y : DirectLdQuestion D)
   352	    (readA : DirectLdAnswer D → alpha)
   353	    (readB : DirectLdAnswer D → beta)
   354	    (a : alpha) (b : beta) :
   355	    ev (strategyQuantumState S)
   356	        (opTensor
   357	          ((ProjMeas.postprocess
   358	            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.A x) (hS.1 x)) readA).outcome a)
   359	          ((ProjMeas.postprocess
   360	            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.B y) (hS.2 y)) readB).outcome b)) =
   361	      ∑ directA ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => readA answer = a),
   362	        ∑ directB ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => readB answer = b),
   363	          strategyBornWeight S x y directA directB := by
   364	  rw [strategyQuantumState_ev_eq_vectorBornWeight]
   365	  simp only [ProjMeas.postprocess, SubMeas.postprocess_outcome,
   366	    matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome]
   367	  rw [vectorBornWeight_finset_sum_left]
   368	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   369	  intro directA _
   370	  rw [vectorBornWeight_finset_sum_right]
   371	  rfl

   373	/-- Correlated residue registers turn two block-diagonal effects into the
   374	uniform average of their matching source-block Born weights. -/
   375	private theorem seedFiberBlockBornAmplitude
   376	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   377	    (A : Fin (L.q / L.m) → Op S.ιA)
   378	    (B : Fin (L.q / L.m) → Op S.ιB) :
   379	    vectorBornAmplitude (seedFiberLiftedState S L)
   380	        (Matrix.blockDiagonal A) (Matrix.blockDiagonal B) =
   381	      (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
